fixtures.invariant: Session cannot restore stale actor access.

fixtures.invariant: Epistemic class cannot be promoted by wording.

fixtures.invariant: Temporal scope may not broaden.

fixtures.invariant: Only actor-perceived accessible relationship view may govern expression.

fixtures.invariant: Audit-only provenance is never model-visible.

fixtures.invariant: Metadata feature use is behavioral dereference.

fixtures.invariant: Forbidden upstream material cannot influence behavior through cache keys.

fixtures.invariant: Source disagreement as such is not actor uncertainty.

fixtures.case: Final plan provides accessible claim but no disclosure decision; renderer chooses whether to reveal it based on plausibility.
fixtures.invariant: Accessibility ceiling does not supply disclosure willingness/planning.

fixtures.case: Renderer chooses which of several accessible claims is salient because no exact salience decision is supplied.
fixtures.invariant: M6 ceiling does not supply salience.

fixtures.case: Renderer suppresses a selected claim because actor seems inhibited, with no named inhibition authority/input.
fixtures.invariant: Inhibition psychology cannot be inferred.

fixtures.case: Renderer adds sadness, anger, warmth, fear, or other affective foreground not supplied by final plan/named authority.
fixtures.invariant: Affective foregrounding is not renderer-owned.

fixtures.invariant: Interlocutor-specific openness requires named authority.

fixtures.case: Renderer selects intimate, terse, defensive, formal, or humorous psychological register from actor history/profile rather than an exact upstream register decision.
fixtures.invariant: Psychological register selection is not wording-only realization.

fixtures.case: Exact already-authorized register constraint and exact final semantic plan are supplied; renderer varies lexical wording without semantic change.
fixtures.invariant: Renderer may realize an already-made semantic/register decision.

fixtures.case: Final plan has zero renderable semantic units; model is prompted to say something natural anyway.
fixtures.invariant: Valid-empty never triggers filler generation.

fixtures.case: Current user turn is included as stimulus-only but model treats its assertion as actor truth.
fixtures.invariant: Stimulus lane is nonauthoritative for actor truth.

fixtures.case: Prior transcript content is directly appended to model prompt without exact plan-admitted presentation-context authority.
fixtures.invariant: Persistence does not grant prompt visibility or semantic authority.

fixtures.case: Prompt contains generic persona/backstory/psyche material to improve naturalness.
fixtures.invariant: Renderer cannot receive a generic hidden persona as semantic completion.

fixtures.case: Model invents a small biographical anecdote consistent with admitted actor facts.
fixtures.invariant: Plausibility is not authority.

fixtures.case: Model output leaks an authority ID, provenance path, source universe, PSEPF detail, or analyst-only explanation.
fixtures.invariant: Audit/analyst truth is non-renderable.

fixtures.case: Same full render-attempt inputs and receipts produce different accepted semantics or different acceptance verdicts.
fixtures.invariant: Acceptance semantics and verdict are deterministic under identical complete replay identity.

fixtures.case: Two separately governed render attempts have different authorized wording-RNG/model receipts but identical semantic plan and both remain semantically equivalent.
fixtures.invariant: Lawful wording variability is allowed only under distinct governed variability receipts.

fixtures.case: Different wording appears with no distinct governed attempt/RNG/model receipt and exact replay is claimed.
fixtures.invariant: Unrecorded nondeterminism is not governed variability.

fixtures.case: Post-render repair deletes an unauthorized clause, produces a new artifact, and the new artifact independently passes the full oracle without replacement semantics.
fixtures.invariant: Only separately governed semantics-subtractive repair may recover a candidate; repaired artifact must be revalidated.

fixtures.case: Repair replaces an unauthorized claim with a different plausible claim not present in the plan.
fixtures.invariant: Repair cannot invent replacement semantics.

fixtures.case: Renderer accepts a similarly shaped object as an actor-safe envelope through duck typing/reflection because concrete M6 binding is missing.
fixtures.invariant: Exact runtime role binding is required; shape similarity is not authority.

fixtures.case: Renderer uses mutable latest M6 runtime or dynamically discovers whichever M6 module is installed.
fixtures.invariant: Runtime binding must be exact and replayable.

fixtures.case: Render succeeds and application treats the rendered artifact as a V3 occurrence without CAN-025 packaging plus ADP-019 admission.
fixtures.invariant: Render success is noncausal and never equals V3 admission.

fixtures.case: A causal candidate is later REJECTED or DEFERRED by ADP-019 and application still advances V3 event or causal-session cursor.
fixtures.invariant: REJECT/DEFER/INVALID produce zero V3 mutation and zero event/causal-session cursor advance.

fixtures.case: Forbidden upstream provenance changes while actor-safe semantics, final V2 plan, lawful V2 inputs, model/policy and RNG receipts are held fixed; wording changes anyway.
fixtures.invariant: Metamorphic noninterference: forbidden upstream material cannot alter render behavior.
